init.title: Device Settings

data.realtime_interval: Realtime update interval, sec (0 = disabled, from 3 to 3600)
data.use_history: Import history (Type 17) to HA external statistics

init.description: If set to 0, realtime mode is disabled (data arrives every 15 minutes). The down topic command ({"type": "12", "up_itvl": "3", "duration": "3600"}) is sent starting from value 3 (values 1 and 2 are not supported by the device). For example, 3–60 sets the update interval in seconds. Changes take effect within 0 to 15 minutes (on the monitor's next communication cycle).
